Know your role

Who can do what?

Roles and available actions in Samar AgriRescue
VisitorBrowse listings without signing in.
BuyerReserve food, contact a producer and report suspicious listings.
Farmer / FisherfolkList and manage surplus; respond to reservations on your own listings.
AdministratorAn assigned role for managing moderation and reports.

Admin is not a public registration choice. Administrative access must be assigned by the platform operator.

    Keep this close

    Reference & reassurance

    Understand the status labels, work around current limitations and make a safe, clear plan before pickup.

    The food listing

    Listing status

    Available
    The listing is offered as available. Check the actual quantity with the producer.
    Reserved
    The listing is marked as held. This is a listing label, not your reservation’s status.
    Sold
    The listing is marked as sold and is no longer offered. This does not automatically complete a reservation.

    Your request

    Reservation status

    Pending
    Your request is waiting for the producer’s decision.
    Confirmed
    The producer accepted the reservation. It does not mean you have paid.
    Cancelled
    The reservation has ended without going ahead, including a cancelled or declined request.
    Completed
    The reservation is recorded as fulfilled. Check its own status rather than inferring it from the listing.
    Confirmed ≠ paid. Sold ≠ a completed reservation.

    Listing and reservation statuses are separate. There is no built-in payment checkout or delivery.

    Who changes a reservation?

    Only the producer can Confirm or Decline via the UI. A buyer can cancel a Pending or Confirmed reservation. Dismissing a notification does not cancel the reservation.

    Questions & troubleshooting

    My email won’t sign me in

    Use your username. Although the sign-in label says “Username or Email”, the backend in the current build only checks the username. If you do not know yours, contact the platform operator.

    Google sign-in shows an error

    The administrator must configure Google sign-in and authorize the current domain. A changed temporary website link can cause an error. Use username sign-in instead, and ask the operator to check the Google setup.

    I forgot my password

    The shipped password-reset flow has a current security limitation: it lacks verified email ownership and a one-time recovery link. “Account found” is not identity verification. Contact the platform operator for help rather than relying on this flow as secure account recovery. Never share your password or an OTP.

    My listing photos won’t upload

    Use JPG, PNG or WEBP only. Each image must be 5 MB or smaller, with no more than 6 images total. Reduce large images before uploading and use genuine photos of the food you are offering.

    I can’t find any food listings

    Clear the search and filters, then browse again. Try a broader category or location. There may simply be no matching available listings right now.

    The quantity I want is unavailable

    Refresh the listing to check current availability. Reduce the requested quantity if appropriate, or choose another listing. Contact the producer to confirm what is actually available before pickup.

    Where do I start a question? Can I reply in Messages?

    Start a question using the message icon on the product listing. The Messages page in the current build has no reply button; do not expect a reply control there. Coordinate using the producer’s available contact details, and avoid sending sensitive information.

    Does dismissing a notification cancel my reservation?

    No. Dismiss only removes the notification. Check your reservation separately and use its cancellation control if the request is Pending or Confirmed and you want to cancel it.

    The website is offline or the old link stopped working

    A quick tunnel is temporary, and its link may change after a reboot or restart. Contact the platform operator for the current link and service status. Do not enter account details on an unfamiliar replacement site.

    People first

    A safer local exchange

    • Never share passwords or one-time passcodes (OTPs), even with someone claiming to be support.
    • Confirm freshness, location, quantity, total cost and pickup time directly with the producer.
    • Check food condition and appropriate storage or cold-chain needs. Do not collect or consume food that appears unsafe.
    • Choose a safe, familiar or public meetup location; tell someone your pickup plan.
    • Report suspicious listings using the app’s reporting control. Do not send money or sensitive details under pressure.
